en: Early becoming: media art, VR and sensory devices 1965–2012
zh: 早期的“成为”：媒体艺术、VR 与感官装置 1965–2012
desc_en: Precursors of becoming-more-than-human XR: 1960s perception helmets and body extensions, early VR worlds with animals, telepresence through robots and animals, sensory-substitution devices and the theory they answer to.
desc_zh: “成为非人” XR 的前身：1960 年代的感知头盔与身体延伸、早期有动物的 VR 世界、借由机器人和动物的远程临场、感官替代装置，以及它们所回应的理论。
